f3a_requirement: Use known synthetic ground truth for classification validation.
design_resolution: Synthetic truth is defined prospectively by construction with separate QPP-present and QPP-absent states; observational labels are excluded from truth.
scientific_rationale: Resolution follows the authoritative F3A entry requirement while preserving synthetic-truth, independence and prospective-freeze boundaries.
remaining_limitation: None for this requirement at the design-contract level; downstream implementation must conform to the frozen contract.

design_resolution: Freeze the F1-continuous asymmetric-flare + power-law-noise generator semantics prospectively, with explicit F3B period-support extension and immutable development/held-out generator identity.
scientific_rationale: The generator assumptions are fully explicit and source-bound before any synthetic series exists; unsupported realism dimensions are fixed and disclosed rather than tuned.
remaining_limitation: Primary realism remains bounded by the validated F1 flare/noise family and fixed independent-white-noise level.

f3a_requirement: Predefine injection–recovery parameter domain and sampling.
design_resolution: Freeze the fully bounded source-supported domain plus exact paired-background sampling counts and deterministic stratified realization registry before generation.
scientific_rationale: The exact domain, sample size, truth-class counts, realization identities and split strategy are prospectively fixed before any random draw or curve exists.
remaining_limitation: Primary precision target applies overall per truth class per split, not to each 36-cell interaction stratum.

f3a_requirement: Freeze a development dataset before rule development.
design_resolution: Freeze 1,800 DEVELOPMENT background realizations, stratified exactly 50 per designated 36-cell nuisance/signal-strength stratum, with paired null and positive series.
scientific_rationale: Development membership is deterministic, source-independent and frozen before rule development.
remaining_limitation: Development data are not materialized yet.

f3a_requirement: Freeze an independent held-out dataset separately.
design_resolution: Freeze 1,800 independent HELDOUT background realization identities and their planned series without drawing noise, periods, phases or flux.
scientific_rationale: Held-out identity/sampling are frozen while the dataset itself remains nonexistent until FINAL_RULE_FREEZE.
remaining_limitation: Held-out outcomes and random draws remain unavailable by design.

design_resolution: Enforce split at background_realization_id: every null/positive and challenge variant from one background stays in exactly one split, with deterministic stratified assignment independent of AFINO.
scientific_rationale: This prevents paired nuisance realizations leaking across development and held-out.
remaining_limitation: Operational enforcement will also be rechecked by the final F3B.1 validator.

f3a_requirement: Freeze the final classification/correction rule before held-out access.
design_resolution: Freeze an explicit two-branch FINAL_RULE_FREEZE process: either an exact promoted candidate rule or the unchanged AFINO baseline, always before held-out generation/access.
scientific_rationale: The policy—not a future candidate outcome—is frozen now; heldout cannot exist before an exact final rule is frozen.
remaining_limitation: candidate_rule_frozen remains false until DEVELOPMENT is completed.

f3a_requirement: Define classification metrics prospectively under known ground truth.
design_resolution: Freeze conditional-on-eligible TP/FN/TN/FP, sensitivity, specificity and FPR with Wilson intervals, and separate end-to-end pipeline metrics.
scientific_rationale: Known synthetic truth makes these classifier metrics valid while preserving explicit denominators and input-admissibility separation.
remaining_limitation: These are synthetic-domain metrics, not observational performance estimates.

design_resolution: Use STRATIFIED_EMPIRICAL as the primary selection-function representation, keeping eligibility, conditional selection and end-to-end selection distinct.
scientific_rationale: The controlled prospective strata support direct empirical estimation without adding an unnecessary fitted-model layer.
remaining_limitation: Sparse/structural no-exposure period cells will be reported rather than modeled away.

f3a_requirement: Separate period-recovery metrics from classification metrics.
design_resolution: Freeze period recovery as a separate evidence plane using absolute error, relative error and log-period ratio only when a selected true positive has a finite recovered period; report coverage over all eligible positives.
scientific_rationale: Nonselection is not converted into a pseudo-period estimate, and no arbitrary recovered-within-X% threshold is introduced.
remaining_limitation: Error distributions are conditional on selected true positives; coverage retains the all-eligible-positive denominator.

f3a_requirement: Retain frozen AFINO 0.5 as the baseline comparator.
design_resolution: Retain AFINO 0.5 commit 6aceac... with the frozen ΔBIC>10 conjunction as mandatory baseline; any correction is optional, development-only and restricted to a two-threshold BIC conjunction.
scientific_rationale: This validates the historical baseline while allowing only a low-complexity, prospectively defined and independently testable correction family.
remaining_limitation: No correction claim exists unless the development and heldout gates are both passed.

f3a_requirement: Resolve BAII-deferred comparator decisions before execution.
design_resolution: Resolve exactly the six comparators frozen as DEFER_TO_F3B in F3A.1. Four are retained as CITATION_ONLY methodological analogues and two training-dependent neural classifiers are UNAVAILABLE_WITH_DOCUMENTED_REASON under the frozen source/training scope. No external comparator is added post hoc to DEVELOPMENT or HELDOUT.
resolution_locator: six rows inherited exactly from phase3a-design-v1 comparator_decisions.csv
scientific_rationale: The project records an explicit prospective disposition for every deferred BAII comparator without forcing implementation of upstream flare detectors or unfrozen training pipelines.
remaining_limitation: No external learned QPP classifier is executed in F3B v1; this limits cross-method performance comparison but does not limit validation of the frozen AFINO baseline under known synthetic truth.

f3a_requirement: Represent F3A inadmissibility/gap regimes where scientifically relevant.
design_resolution: Separate the primary contiguous-all-good regime from two bounded secondary structural input-admissibility challenges: one internal non-peak masked cadence and peak-cadence masking.
scientific_rationale: F3A establishes that input inadmissibility must remain visible. The challenge regimes are prospectively defined methodological stress cases and are not recoded as non-selection.
remaining_limitation: Challenge frequencies are not observational prevalence estimates.

f3a_requirement: Do not use published observational labels as physical truth.
design_resolution: The truth contract explicitly sets observational_reference_ground_truth=false and prohibits PUBLISHED_QPP_REFERENCE / PUBLISHED_NOT_SELECTED_REFERENCE as synthetic truth.
scientific_rationale: Resolution follows the authoritative F3A entry requirement while preserving synthetic-truth, independence and prospective-freeze boundaries.
remaining_limitation: None for this requirement at the design-contract level; downstream implementation must conform to the frozen contract.

f3a_requirement: Do not reuse F2/F3A observational events as independent held-out validation.
design_resolution: The truth contract explicitly marks all F2/F3A observational events NOT_HELDOUT_TRUTH and prohibits them from independent held-out validation.
scientific_rationale: Resolution follows the authoritative F3A entry requirement while preserving synthetic-truth, independence and prospective-freeze boundaries.
remaining_limitation: None for this requirement at the design-contract level; downstream implementation must conform to the frozen contract.

f3a_requirement: Retain numerical stability as a separate evidence plane.
design_resolution: Retain numerical stability as a separate evidence plane and freeze a deterministic DEVELOPMENT-only 36-background/72-series subset with optimizer seeds 0..9, explicit diagnostics and no heldout access.
scientific_rationale: The subset spans all 36 primary design strata while avoiding a full ten-seed rerun of the simulation; only optimizer seed varies and numerical stability remains distinct from classification performance.
remaining_limitation: Stability over seeds 0..9 does not establish uniqueness of the optimizer optimum.

f3a_requirement: Keep candidate discovery outside the initial F3B validation scope.
design_resolution: The evidence-plane contract explicitly excludes observational candidate discovery from F3B.1/F3B validation scope.
scientific_rationale: Resolution follows the authoritative F3A entry requirement while preserving synthetic-truth, independence and prospective-freeze boundaries.
remaining_limitation: None for this requirement at the design-contract level; downstream implementation must conform to the frozen contract.

f3a_requirement: Freeze F3B success/failure and promotion criteria before execution.
design_resolution: Freeze separate baseline-characterization, candidate-development and heldout-validation success/failure gates, including exact noninferiority and practical-improvement margins before data generation.
scientific_rationale: The gates distinguish execution completeness, development promotion and independent heldout validation and prohibit same-heldout retuning.
remaining_limitation: Actual gate outcomes remain unknown until the appropriate future phase.
